rlm_tools.description: Actual recorded RLM function actions. Null means unrecorded; historical traces are never backfilled. A list does not assert that an interrupted generation has a complete trace.
rlm_tools.title: Rlm Tools

identity.description: Presentation identity recorded when the export or share review was created. Null means historical identity was not recorded; it never uses today's branding.

source_ids.description: Admitted native source scope; actual content use requires separate execution-read evidence.
source_ids.title: Source Ids

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the actual ToolReturnPart JSON serialization, sorted keys, compact UTF-8.
result_sha256.title: Result Sha256

result_kind.description: tool_return is preserved into subsequent SDK history. accepted_final and execution_failure seal the actual host result locally without asserting a subsequent provider delivery.
result_kind.title: Result Kind

execution_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact public VM feed dataclass, sorted keys, compact UTF-8.
execution_sha256.title: Execution Sha256

BinaryDownload.description: Authenticated HTTP binary response. SDK metadata wrapper includes bytes/blob, Content-Type, ETag, RFC5987 filename and not_modified. Only authorized avatar304 is accepted.

AvatarUpload.description: Raw PNG/JPEG/WebP, at most2MiB; server sanitizes to JPEG.

description: Canonical wire DTOs. Unknown additive response fields are accepted. Exact domain decimals and unsafe integers remain strings.
